description: This Java class 'HolidayRepositoryWrapper' in the package 'org.apache.fineract.organisation.holiday.domain' provides a wrapper around the 'HolidayRepository' interface. It adds utility functions such as null checking, error handling, and specific query methods related to holiday data, including methods to find, save, delete, and check for holidays by office ID and date.

classes.name: HolidayRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for the 'HolidayRepository' that adds NULL checks and error handling capabilities for holiday-related operations.

methods.name: HolidayRepositoryWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with an instance of 'HolidayRepository'.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a Holiday by ID, throwing a 'HolidayNotFoundException' if not found.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Saves and immediately flushes a Holiday entity.

methods.name: findByOfficeIdAndGreaterThanDate
methods.description: Finds holidays for a specific office after a certain date with active status.

methods.name: findUnprocessed
methods.description: Finds all unprocessed holidays with active status.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given date is a holiday for the specified office.
